// ReportAction: find the report in the context and publish its generated file.
void z8_application_dispatch_query_report(wstring className) {
    z8_application_dispatch_query_report_target(className, null);
}
private void z8_application_dispatch_query_report_target(wstring className, Z8Object query) {
    auto request = z8_application_require_request();
    auto params = z8_nonnull(request.parameters);
    if (request.writer.scopes.length != 2) throw new Exception("response object is not open");
    if (params.z8_get("action"w) != "report"w) throw new Exception("unsupported query action");
    if (!z8_application_may_execute(z8_nonnull(request.session), className, "report"w)) throw new Exception("request access denied");
    auto keys = params.z8_keys();
    for (long i; i < keys.z8_size(); ++i) {
        auto key = keys.z8_get(i);
        if (key == "request"w || key == "session"w || key == "server"w || key == "ip"w || key == "action"w ||
            key == "id"w || key == "format"w || key == "name"w || key == "recordId"w || key == "query"w || key == "link"w) continue;
        if (key is null || params.z8_get(key).length) throw new Exception("unsupported report parameter");
    }
    if (query is null) query = z8_object_new_instance_native(z8_string_required(className));
    if (!z8_native_is_instance("org.zenframework.z8.server.base.query.Query"w, query)) throw new Exception("report requires a Query");
    auto privileges = z8_nonnull(z8_nonnull(z8_nonnull(request.session).user).privileges);
    z8_application_accessible_action_query(query, privileges, params.z8_get("query"w), params.z8_get("link"w));
    auto report = z8_action_find_member(query, params.z8_get("id"w));
    if (!z8_native_is_instance(z8_report_name, report)) throw new Exception("report not found");
    auto state = z8_report_state(report);
    auto format = params.z8_get("format"w), name = params.z8_get("name"w);
    if (format !is null) state.format = format;
    if (name !is null) state.name = name;
    auto id = params.z8_get("recordId"w);
    auto result = z8_report_run(report, id is null ? null : z8_guid_parse(id));
    z8_nonnull(request.monitor).print(z8_report_publish(result));
}
